name: Quality Switch Inc
description: Quality Switch is a manufacturer of a wide variety of de-energized tap changers and electrical switches used primarily in transformers and load centers, but can be applied wherever power is controlled. The current company executive director, Larry Dix, came to Quality Switch in 1995 with a background as an engineer in the transformer industry. He shifted the focus of the company to engineering and design in addition to manufacturing. The majority of the switch designs are backed by independent or in-house testing. These include short circuit tests, impulse tests, applied voltage tests, mechanical endurance tests and various other tests on basic switch designs. Periodically, we retest designs and materials to verify compliance with original tests.
capabilities: Quality Switch also has capabilities to set up various mechanical endurance tests as well.
